about.title: About Crucible Leadership Guild
about.description: Who is behind Crucible Leadership Guild: [one line on your background]. Practical leadership tools and mentoring.
about.heading: About Crucible Leadership Guild
paragraphs: Crucible Leadership Guild (CLG) makes practical leadership tools and offers one-on-one mentoring for leaders and engineers. It is run by Zack Turnbow, a seasoned software developer and leader who has interviewed, hired and mentored software engineers for 15 years at various companies.

The idea behind CLG is simple: most people are promoted for being good at the work and then trained only in the mechanics of management. Our tools and mentoring focus on the judgment that comes after: how to write a fair review, how to tell whether a moment needs leading, managing or mentoring, and how to grow as a leader without losing what made you good at the work.

Writing reviews can be daunting since it directlyimpacts the people you lead. The Review Season Kit provides assistance in areas that can be hard to navigate as a leader. There are other times as a leader that you would have liked to be more effective. You might have all the necessary skills but perhaps you need to know when the right time to use a particular skill. The Wrong Mode Course helps point out the right time to use your skills to be an effective leader.
CLG is a Florida LLC. You can reach us at [leadership@crucibleleadershipguild.com](mailto:leadership@crucibleleadershipguild.com). We sell to customers in the United States.

products.name: CLG Wrong Mode Course
products.summary: A course on leading, managing and mentoring: how to choose the right mode for the moment.
description: Leadership, management and mentoring are three modes one person switches between, often in the same week, not three separate roles. People rarely fail because they lack one of them. They fail because they use the wrong mode at the wrong moment, like mentoring someone who needed a clear decision.

Most people are promoted for being good at the work and trained only in the mechanics of management. This course builds leadership and mentoring deliberately, with a three-question diagnostic, exercises and discussion questions, and sources for every cited idea.
includes: Module 1: Three modes, not three roles
Module 4: Managing, including warning signs of over- and under-managing
Module 6: Putting the modes together, with a capstone
